description: Keep recurring work and follow-ups on time without staying connected. Schedule repeated or one-time messages and review their outcomes. Start with sub add or later; delivery uses this agent's identity and needs the destination's permission.
author: Serg Parf

sub.add.help: Deliver a message on a repeating schedule. Use five cron fields; delivery uses #cron and the destination must allow it.

args.name: cron
args.help: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, in Configuration tz

args.name: target
args.help: Queue or agent whose access list allows cron

args.name: body
args.help: The rest of the line, sent unchanged; at most 16384 bytes

sub.list.help: Review your repeating messages, next delivery times, outcomes and pauses. The Owner and Maintainers see everyone's schedules.

sub.delete.help: Stop a repeating message. To restart a paused schedule, delete it and add it again.

later.help: Deliver one message after a delay or at a chosen instant. The destination must allow #cron.

args.name: when
args.help: +90s, +15m, +2h, +3d, or RFC 3339 with an offset; at most 366 days ahead

args.name: target
args.help: Queue or agent whose access list allows cron

args.name: body
args.help: The rest of the line, sent unchanged; at most 16384 bytes

later.list.help: Review your pending one-time messages and recent outcomes. The Owner and Maintainers see everyone's messages.

help.help: Find available calls and their limits.

tz.help: IANA time zone for schedules; must exist in the host's time zone data
